Name: ATTACHEFFECT_TABLE_PARAM_ST
Description: Weighted tables that roll effects onto relics and weapons. Rows that share an ID form one table; an entry is skipped when its effect, or another effect with its Compatibility ID, is already on the item.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Standard row header flag: set rows are left out of the network test build. Appears unused by the game. Retail: set on 12,844 of 22,088 rows.

Fields.Name: Attached Effect
Fields.Description: AttachEffectParam row this entry can give. An entry is skipped when the same effect, or one with the same Compatibility ID, was already rolled on the item.

Fields.Name: Roll Weight: Base
Fields.Description: Weight of this entry in the weighted draw among the table's rows (chance = weight / sum of the remaining entries' weights).

Fields.Name: Roll Weight: DLC Owned
Fields.Description: Weight used instead of Roll Weight: Base when the game sees the DLC as owned. -1: use the base weight.
